title: Prepare logistic regression design matrices
description: You standardize features, split rows, and add intercept columns.

steps.description: You standardize the complete X matrix and retain mu and sigma. This happens before splitting the rows.

steps.question: Does the split use raw X or standardized X_std?
steps.answer: It uses X_std with test_size=0.25. Both feature splits therefore come from the standardized matrix.

steps.description: You print the split dimensions. The recording reports 450 training rows and 150 test rows, each with two features.
You call add_intercept separately on training and test features. Phi_tr and Phi_te become the design matrices used by later model calls.
